blocks.text: If you want to upgrade to Android 10, you must:

blocks.item: Upgrade your devices (excluding Samsung devices) to Zscaler Client Connector 1.5.2 for Android. To learn more, see January 6, 2020 Release Notes: Zscaler Client Connector 1.5.2 for Android.
Upgrade your Samsung devices to Zscaler Client Connector 1.5.3 for Android. To learn more, see March 17, 2020 Release Notes: Zscaler Client Connector 1.5.3 for Android.
